Spellthrone — the court roster

Both courts at full strength, same scale, same hexes — back row EMBER, front row FROST, mirrored. Twelve pieces now: the Enablers and Scouts have joined (the court Exclusives — the two hounds — are still being refined). Every piece opens on Idle + its court's FX: Ember flickers, Frost breathes slow. Tap any card below — or tap a piece on the stage — to bring it up solo, on its own turntable, at full size or at true phone size. All GLBs share the rig contract: named parts (base, body, head, the role piece — staff / shield / bow — and an orb carrying the magic) the game can pose independently.
